svg.aria-label: Diagram: the sections of one MUSE-style resting ECG XML record (Waveform, TestDemographics, PatientDemographics, RestingECGMeasurements, Diagnosis) plus linked clinical tables, and how each becomes either the 8 by 2500 waveform tensor at 250 Hz or the tabular feature vector.
svg.title: What one ECG record contains
svg.text: checked against byte and sample counts,
clamped to the lead high/low limits
III, aVR, aVL, aVF: derived from I and II
selection window only, not a feature
Race dropped: too many missing values
Abnormal flag if any statement reads:
1° AV block, AF, RBBB, LBBB, ST-T change,
rhythm · lead II · first 4 of 10 s
outside the XML · joined on IPPAT
Age at first ICI, ICI group, baseline EF,
History before ICI: ACS, arrhythmia, CAD,
